definitions.S_i: a root-free v3-reachable state inside the frozen N^2 representation envelope
definitions.v_i: number of live Boolean variables in S_i
definitions.r_i: number of live root variables in S_i; root-free means r_i=0

lemma_1_root_free_potential.name: ROOT_FREE_PHI_EQUALS_LIVE_VARIABLE_COUNT
lemma_1_root_free_potential.proof: The first term of the frozen potential is multiplied by r_i=0.

lemma_2_atomic_v3_live_count_descent.name: V3_ATOMIC_PLAN_DECREASES_LIVE_COUNT_BY_AT_LEAST_ONE
lemma_2_atomic_v3_live_count_descent.statement: Every admitted v3 extension-tail plan satisfies v_(i+1)<=v_i-1.
proof: The v3 guard records live_before and requires at least two live variables with no live root variables.
The macro introduces at most one fresh extension variable e and introduces no other variable identifiers.
The frozen plan eliminates pivot1 and pivot2, which must be distinct and both belong to live_before; the fresh macro variable itself is forbidden as a descent pivot.
Exact Davis-Putnam elimination removes the eliminated pivot variable from its result and does not introduce any new variable identifier.
Therefore after the two eliminations the live set is contained in (live_before minus {pivot1,pivot2}) union {e}, so its cardinality is at most v_i-1.
The implementation independently enforces the same conclusion through after_phi<before_phi.

lemma_3_original_N_step_bound.name: V3_SUCCESSFUL_SUFFIX_HAS_AT_MOST_N_SQUARED_MACROSTEPS
lemma_3_original_N_step_bound.statement: Any contiguous root-free suffix consisting of successful admitted v3 atomic plans has length at most N^2.
proof: Every live variable occurs in at least one literal, so v_i<=literal_occurrences(S_i)<=state_units(S_i)<=N^2.
Lemma 2 decreases v by at least one at every successful v3 macrostep and v is a nonnegative integer.
Hence there can be at most v_entry<=N^2 successful v3 macrosteps before the suffix terminates or another lane becomes terminal/applicable.

lemma_4_discovery_is_polynomial_under_en.name: ONE_V3_DISCOVERY_PASS_IS_POLYNOMIAL_IN_ORIGINAL_N_UNDER_N2_ENVELOPE
lemma_4_discovery_is_polynomial_under_en.statement: For one root-free state with explicit representation size <=N^2, the frozen discover_extension_tail_plan_v3 search performs only polynomially many syntactic candidate attempts and each attempted macro/elimination/replay operation has polynomial work in N.
proof: OR-pair candidates are drawn only from literal pairs occurring in the explicit CNF; their number is polynomial in the explicit representation size.
For each macro candidate, pivot1 and pivot2 range over the pre-macro live-variable list, so there are at most v_i^2<=N^4 ordered pivot attempts.
The state cap prevents any admitted intermediate explicit representation from exceeding N^2 units; a failed capped elimination stops once the monotone raw cap is crossed.

Clause scans, pair generation, canonical set insertion, fixed-depth elimination, certificate serialization and independent replay are finite nested loops over polynomially bounded explicit objects; no subset-of-variables search, SAT oracle, semantic equivalence oracle or unbounded chain depth is invoked by v3.
Variable identifiers remain polynomial-bit integers because fresh extension creation is bounded by the frozen extension cap and uses deterministic fresh identifiers.

corollary.name: V3_TAIL_RUNTIME_IS_POLYNOMIAL_CONDITIONAL_ON_AVAILABILITY_AND_ENVELOPE_PRESERVATION
corollary.statement: If every nonterminal root-free state reached by the frozen machine either terminates in an earlier exact lane or admits a v3 plan whose intermediates preserve the N^2 envelope, then the root-free suffix has polynomial total runtime in original N.
corollary.reason: At most N^2 successful v3 macrosteps by Lemma 3, with polynomial discovery/execution/replay work per macrostep by Lemma 4.

remaining_open_obligation.name: V3_ROOT_FREE_TAIL_AVAILABILITY
remaining_open_obligation.statement: For every nonterminal root-free state reachable under the frozen decision core after earlier exact lanes and ordinary capped elimination fail, discover_extension_tail_plan_v3 returns an admitted exact plan before the extension cap is exhausted.
remaining_open_obligation.failure_meaning: A reachable state with no earlier exact decision, no ordinary capped pivot and no admitted v3 plan is a concrete OPEN witness for the current frozen theorem machine; it does not prove P!=NP.

next_exact_target: Prove or refute V3_ROOT_FREE_TAIL_AVAILABILITY on reachable states. Separate candidate-existence, first-elimination-cap, second-elimination-cap and extension-cap exhaustion as typed failure obligations.
